title: pilosella hypeurya subsp. obtusifolia
intro: Pilosella hypeurya subsp. obtusifolia, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family, is a plant species that has gained attention for its potential health benefits. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including digestive issues and inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents present in Pilosella hypeurya subsp. obtusifolia include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of this plant, but it is believed to have antioxidant and protective effects on the body.
